title: periods.termination_credit_days
description: Unused days of a pay-in-advance period at termination and the unused amount before coupons and taxes (BE-SP-58, BE-SP-59).

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

fee_plan_amount_cents.description: Plan amount recorded on the last subscription fee (null: the plan amount).

day_price.description: amount / period_days as a binary64 quotient (BE-SP-38; compared as float64).

unused_amount_cents.description: remaining_days x day_price in binary64, i.e. remaining_days x (amount / period_days) with the quotient rounded first (BE-SP-38, BE-SP-58); not rounded to cents. The corrected profile proposes the exact decimal value (RBD-55, periods.termination_credit_days.009x).
